For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Understanding how to implement Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is critical for creators facing platform restrictions. Traditional payment processors often impose high fees and barriers that inhibit access to global markets. For instance, platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% per transaction, significantly cutting into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, meaning that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you would retain an additional $921. This fee difference not only impacts your bottom line but also enhances your ability to invest in your business and reach a wider audience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for accepting Bitcoin payments involves several components that work together seamlessly. You begin by hosting your digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which allow you to store and deliver your content for free. Next, you utilize backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage payment processing and order fulfillment. NOWPayments serves as your payment gateway, automatically verifying on-chain transactions in real-time. This architecture not only reduces reliance on conventional payment systems but also ensures that you maintain full control over your data and assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is tailored for digital creators across regions where conventional payment methods are scarce or excessively expensive. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this infrastructure empowers you to transact freely and securely. By utilizing Bitcoin payments, you eliminate the need for intermediaries, allowing you to maximize your earnings and maintain ownership of your products. This is especially crucial for creators in countries like Nigeria or Venezuela, where currency instability can complicate financial transactions. With this setup, you can confidently sell your products globally without the fear of payment rejections or exorbitant fees.
NOWPayments cuts transaction fees to just 0.5%, freeing up more of your earnings.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of Bitcoin payments relies on several key components. First, the hosting platform, whether GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensures your products are accessible to customers. Next, the backend logic, managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automates transactions and order processing. NOWPayments serves as the crucial link for cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Lastly, your chosen storage solution, either Supabase or Google Sheets, keeps track of customer orders. Together, these components create a robust infrastructure that empowers you to sell digital products without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start accepting Bitcoin payments for your digital downloads, follow these steps: First, choose a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to publish your products. Next, set up backend logic using Google Apps Script to handle payment processing and fulfillment. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you configure the payment verification correctly. Store order data using Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access. Finally, promote your store using social media or other channels, directing customers to your products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. With these steps, you can establish a fully operational digital commerce stack today.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by implementing a Bitcoin payment solution. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept Bitcoin transactions with a low fee structure, ensuring you keep more of your earnings. This allows you to sell various digital products directly from your website without relying on conventional payment platforms.
Gain full ownership of your products and data without platform dependencies.

If you're exploring options for setting up a digital download store without the constraints of traditional payment platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the blueprints and templates you need to create and manage a sovereign commerce stack that leverages Bitcoin payments. For further details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I integrate Bitcoin payments into my existing store?

To integrate Bitcoin payments, choose a payment processor like NOWPayments and follow their integration guide. This usually involves setting up an account, configuring payment options, and integrating the provided API into your existing store’s backend.
What are the benefits of using Bitcoin for digital downloads?

Using Bitcoin for digital downloads reduces transaction fees, enhances security, and allows you to accept payments from a global audience without relying on traditional banking systems. This setup ensures you maintain full control over your transactions.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products with this setup?

Yes, this setup supports various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. You can configure your platform to handle different types of content while maintaining a streamlined payment process.
What if my customers are unfamiliar with Bitcoin?
Provide educational resources about Bitcoin and how to use it for transactions. This can include guides or links to platforms where they can purchase Bitcoin and make payments easily.
Is there ongoing support after setting up my payment system?
Yes, after deploying your infrastructure, you have access to support during the initial setup period. You can also refer to documentation and community resources for ongoing assistance.
